overview: 今日共收录72篇文献，覆盖机器学习、计算物理和功能材料方向。
trends: 文献主要涉及结构—性质建模、有限温度/动力学模拟以及材料电子与磁性问题；缺少原文细节的条目不作定量推断。

full_list.title_en: Efficient Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials
full_list.title_zh: 高效的机器学习原子间势
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.22444v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) reach an accuracy close to quantum mechanical reference calculations at a small fraction of the cost. Efficiency is the purpose of MLIPs, yet strategies for efficient MLIPs have not been reviewed systematically. This review takes efficiency as its guideline. To compare MLIPs on a common footing, we represent them in a complete basis expansion, the Atomic Cluster Expansion (ACE) and its graph generalization (GRACE). The expansion is canonical, built from products of single-particle functions. Classical interatomic potentials, such as the embedded-atom method, and many modern MLIPs, including equivariant transformers, can be represented within this expansion. Much of the apparent diversity of MLIP architectures therefore reflects how non-linearity, layer coupling and optimization are handled rather than which interactions the models can represent. We show how the cost of an MLIP becomes linear in system size and, at fixed rank of the tensor decomposition, in model complexity, and we discuss the role of machine learning, which provides non-linear parameterizations and optimization. Because efficiency is meaningful only at a given accuracy, we also compare accuracy and cost. On the Matbench Discovery leaderboard, models with three to five layers approach the accuracy of deeper models, and one basis, truncated along the Pareto front of error and speed, spans more than two orders of magnitude in cost. Ultimately, training data determine the quality of any MLIP.
full_list.abstract_zh: 机器学习原子间势 (MLIP) 的精度接近量子力学参考计算，而成本仅为其一小部分。效率是多层投资计划的目的，但高效多层投资计划的策略尚未得到系统的审查。本次审查以效率为指导方针。为了在共同基础上比较 MLIP，我们用完整的基础扩展、原子簇扩展 (ACE) 及其图泛化 (GRACE) 来表示它们。该展开式是规范的，由单粒子函数的乘积构建。经典的原子间势（例如嵌入原子方法）和许多现代 MLIP（包括等变变压器）可以在此展开中表示。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 机器学习原子间势 (MLIP) 的精度接近量子力学参考计算，而成本仅为其一小部分。效率是多层投资计划的目的，但高效多层投资计划的策略尚未得到系统的审查。本次审查以效率为指导方针。为了在共同基础上比较 MLIP，我们用完整的基础扩展、原子簇扩展 (ACE) 及其图泛化 (GRACE) 来表示它们。该展开式是规范的，由单粒子函数的乘积构建。经典的原子间势（例如嵌入原子方法）和许多现代 MLIP（包括等变变压器）可以在此展开中表示。因此，MLIP 架构的许多明显多样性反映了如何处理非线性、层耦合和优化，而不是模型可以表示哪些交互。我们展示了 MLIP 的成本如何在系统规模上以及在张量分解的固定秩下在模型复杂度上变得线性，并且我们讨论了机器学习的作用，它提供了非线性参数化和优化。由于效率仅在给定精度下才有意义，因此我们还比较了精度和成本。在 Matbench Discovery 排行榜上，三到五层的模型接近更深层次模型的精度，而一个基础（沿着误差和速度的 Pareto 前沿截断）的成本跨越两个数量级以上。最终，训练数据决定了任何 MLIP 的质量。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：等变神经网络与对称性保持表示、团簇展开与构型统计。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对《高效的机器学习原子间势》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Spin-Adapted Neural-Network Backflow Wavefunctions for Excited States of Strongly Correlated Open-Shell Systems
full_list.title_zh: 强相关开壳系统激发态的自旋适应神经网络回流波函数
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.22735v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Building on the success of neural-network quantum states (NQS) for molecular ground states, multi-state frameworks such as natural excited states (NES) [Pfau et al., Science 2024, 385, eadn0137] extend NQS to chemically important excited states. However, without control over total spin, such calculations can require the inclusion of many intervening states of other spins, particularly in strongly correlated systems with dense low-energy spectra. We therefore generalize our previously developed spin-adapted neural network backflow (SA-NNBF) ansatz [Li et al., arXiv:2604.06841 (2026)] to improve its variational flexibility for excited-state calculations within a prescribed spin sector. We establish the universality of this extended ansatz within the chosen orbital space and spin sector, and use numerical benchmarks to assess how parameter allocation affects the ansatz's accuracy. With the spin-adapted ansatz, we are able to directly optimize the first excited state (a singlet) of O₂ without using any multi-state frameworks. Combining the extended ansatz with NES, we obtain low-lying triplet states of O₂ and singlet states of the [Fe₂S₂(SCH₃)₄]²⁻ cluster without including intervening states of other spins. Both the single-state and NES calculations achieve chemical accuracy relative to the exact energies. Our work provides a practical NQS framework for targeting excited states of prescribed spin in strongly correlated systems.
full_list.abstract_zh: 基于分子基态神经网络量子态 (NQS) 的成功，自然激发态 (NES) 等多态框架 [Pfau et al., Science 2024, 385, eadn0137] 将 NQS 扩展到化学上重要的激发态。然而，如果不控制总自旋，此类计算可能需要包含其他自旋的许多干预状态，特别是在具有密集低能谱的强相关系统中。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 基于分子基态神经网络量子态 (NQS) 的成功，自然激发态 (NES) 等多态框架 [Pfau et al., Science 2024, 385, eadn0137] 将 NQS 扩展到化学上重要的激发态。然而，如果不控制总自旋，此类计算可能需要包含其他自旋的许多干预状态，特别是在具有密集低能谱的强相关系统中。因此，我们概括了之前开发的自旋适应神经网络回流（SA-NNBF）ansatz [Li et al., arXiv:2604.06841 (2026)]，以提高其在指定自旋扇区内激发态计算的变分灵活性。我们在选定的轨道空间和自旋扇区内建立了这种扩展 ansatz 的普遍性，并使用数值基准来评估参数分配如何影响 ansatz 的准确性。借助自旋适应 ansatz，我们能够直接优化 O2 的第一激发态（单线态），而无需使用任何多态框架。将扩展 ansatz 与 NES 相结合，我们获得了 O2 的低位三重态和 [Fe2S2(SCH3)4]2- 团簇的单重态，而不包括其他自旋的介入态。单态和 NES 计算都实现了相对于精确能量的化学精度。我们的工作提供了一个实用的 NQS 框架，用于针对强相关系统中指定自旋的激发态。
full_list.summary: 基于分子基态神经网络量子态 (NQS) 的成功，自然激发态 (NES) 等多态框架 [Pfau et al., Science 2024, 385, eadn0137] 将 NQS 扩展到化学上重要的激发态。然而，如果不控制总自旋，此类计算可能需要包含其他自旋的许多干预状态，特别是在具有密集低能谱的强相关系统中。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《强相关开壳系统激发态的自旋适应神经网络回流波函数》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Stein Kernelized Molecular Dynamics for Active Learning of Interatomic Potentials
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Stein Kernelized Molecular Dynamics for Active Learning of Interatomic Potentials
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2606.04100v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) enable efficient and accurate atomistic simulations but depend critically on the quality and diversity of the training data. We introduce Stein kernelized molecular dynamics (SKMD), an enhanced sampling method that uses interacting particle dynamics to acquire informative training configurations for the fine-tuning of MLIPs. SKMD corresponds to a stochastic variant of Stein variational gradient descent that is adapted for molecular dynamics by incorporating asynchronous particle updates and a kernel of global atomic descriptors, which provides a symmetry-aware measure of configurational similarity. Unlike other enhanced samplers used in molecular dynamics, SKMD maintains the Boltzmann distribution as a stationary distribution of its dynamics in the appropriate asymptotic limit. This property enforces a balance between the exploration of diverse configurations and attraction toward high-probability regions of the energy landscape. We further propose an approach to efficient online data acquisition using an adaptive stopping criterion that selects non-redundant training data over the course of simulation. We demonstrate SKMD for the active learning of a neural network model of the Müller--Brown potential, a MACE interatomic potential for alanine dipeptide, and a MACE foundation model with a DFT oracle for predicting the Pandey reconstruction of the Si(111) surface. Compared to active learning baselines, our method achieves higher model accuracy in fewer training iterations.

full_list.title_en: Dynamics and transport in LiF using classical and machine learned interatomic potentials
full_list.title_zh: 使用经典和机器学习的原子间势研究 LiF 中的动力学和传输
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.21900v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We perform molecular dynamics simulations of molten Lithium Fluoride, comparing the classical Buckingham and Born-Huggins-Mayer potentials with machine-learnt interatomic potentials - the MACE-MP-0b3 (small) foundation model potential, and a fine-tuned version thereof. We find that the MACE-MP-0b3, out-of-the-box, is able to accurately reproduce the experimental shear viscosity across the liquid state comparable with polarisable potentials despite not itself being polarisable. Previous viscosities computed using classical potentials are under-predicted, which has previously been attributed to a suppressed melting temperature. Prompted by this we compare the melting points of these potentials. We find that the machine-learnt potentials address the significant underestimation of the melting point of the classical potentials, though the refined potential and the foundation model differ significantly between themselves. We probe the microscopic structure and dynamics of each model to further elucidate the considerable change in viscosity between classical and machine-learnt potentials. We find that, despite their lower melting temperature, classical potentials produce considerably stiffer, higher frequency, single-particle and collective charge-transport dynamics on account of their fixed charges. However, in the long-wavelength limit, the many-body machine-learnt potentials feature more elastic collective motion that governs the diffusion of momentum and is therefore responsible for the enhanced shear viscosity.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们对熔融氟化锂进行分子动力学模拟，将经典的 Buckingham 和 Born-Huggins-Mayer 势与机器学习的原子间势 - MACE-MP-0b3（小）基础模型势及其微调版本进行比较。我们发现，开箱即用的 MACE-MP-0b3 能够准确地再现与可极化电势相当的液态实验剪切粘度，尽管它本身不是可极化的。以前使用经典势计算的粘度预测不足，这归因于熔化温度受到抑制。受此启发，我们比较了这些电势的熔点。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们对熔融氟化锂进行分子动力学模拟，将经典的 Buckingham 和 Born-Huggins-Mayer 势与机器学习的原子间势 - MACE-MP-0b3（小）基础模型势及其微调版本进行比较。我们发现，开箱即用的 MACE-MP-0b3 能够准确地再现与可极化电势相当的液态实验剪切粘度，尽管它本身不是可极化的。以前使用经典势计算的粘度预测不足，这归因于熔化温度受到抑制。受此启发，我们比较了这些电势的熔点。我们发现机器学习势解决了经典势熔点的显着低估问题，尽管精炼势和基础模型之间存在显着差异。我们探讨了每个模型的微观结构和动力学，以进一步阐明经典势和机器学习势之间粘度的显着变化。我们发现，尽管它们的熔化温度较低，但经典势由于其固定电荷而产生相当僵硬、频率更高的单粒子和集体电荷传输动力学。然而，在长波长限制下，多体机器学习势具有更具弹性的集体运动，它控制动量的扩散，因此导致剪切粘度增强。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入非绝热分子动力学、电子—声子耦合、Wannier/GW-BSE 和载流子输运。从摘要能确认的线索包括：分子动力学与有限温度轨迹，以及声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“先用高精度电子结构和声子/电子—声子矩阵元建立小规模基准，再训练可迁移 Hamiltonian 或 ML 势，最后在长时间尺度非绝热 MD、输运或界面电荷转移中验证”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：非绝热分子动力学、电子—声子耦合、Wannier/GW-BSE 和载流子输运已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到卤化物钙钛矿、二维半导体、FeSe、光电界面和能源材料。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注声子、有限温度和输运性质在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。

full_list.title_en: When Do Tensor Product Paths Matter? A Group-Theoretic Analysis of Equivariant Interatomic Potentials
full_list.title_zh: 张量积路径何时重要？等变原子间势的群论分析
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.21683v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Tensor-product (TP) layers in equivariant interatomic potentials encode angular interactions through symmetry-allowed paths. Yet local site symmetry can make an allowed path carry no signal after neighbor aggregation. We call this effect Aggregation Cancellation. In a scalar-input first layer, equal-species neighbors on a complete site-symmetry orbit share scalar and radial factors, reducing their angular contribution to a spherical-harmonic orbit sum. If the restricted degree-l representation has no trivial component, this sum and the corresponding path vanish for any learned radial weight. For an ideal Oₕ octahedral orbit, this removes the l_edge=1,2,3 classes. Beyond the first layer, the factorisation no longer holds, so cancellation is no longer guaranteed; we instead ask whether affected paths remain less important on average. We test the two levels separately in NequIP: matched-radius TiO₆ probes examine first-layer cancellation, whereas a within-model CaTiO₃ comparison and six OMat24 models examine the importance bias. We then rank paths on training frames, choose the pruning fraction on validation frames, and evaluate frozen masks on held-out tests. At the highest evaluated fraction (60% of 174 paths), force mean absolute error (MAE) changes are 1.42%, 0.04%, and 1.83% for CaTiO₃, OMat24 Oₕ-cubic, and OMat24 low-symmetry data, respectively. The masks imply 67.12-71.94% potential TP-operation reduction and 59.77% potential edge multilayer perceptron (MLP) reduction; these are structural proxies, not measured speedups. The results connect local symmetry to path redundancy and pruning robustness in NequIP; transfer to other architectures remains open.
full_list.abstract_zh: 等变原子间势中的张量积 (TP) 层通过允许对称的路径对角度相互作用进行编码。然而，本地站点对称性可能会导致允许的路径在邻居聚合后不承载任何信号。我们称这种效应为聚合取消。在标量输入第一层中，完整位点对称轨道上的同种邻居共享标量和径向因子，从而减少了它们对球谐轨道和的角度贡献。如果受限的 l 度表示没有微不足道的分量，则对于任何学习的径向权重，该总和以及相应的路径都会消失。对于理想的 Oₕ 八面体轨道，这会删除 l_edge=1,2,3 类。

full_list.title_en: QCap: a physics-corrected graph neural network for the capacitance matrix of any planar superconducting device layout
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：QCap: a physics-corrected graph neural network for the capacitance matrix of any planar superconducting device layout
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.22057v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Electromagnetic simulations of device layouts to extract capacitance are computationally intensive, a major obstacle to accurate design of circuit devices. Machine learning models can bypass these simulations, but previous approaches have been restricted to layouts using only particular components, and require thousands of simulations of those same components as training data. We present QCap, a model that accurately predicts the Maxwell capacitance matrix of an arbitrary superconducting device layout in seconds, compared to minutes to hours of Ansys Q3D simulations. We develop a novel design-embedding algorithm that converts the layout into a universal graph format, allowing the model to work with any layout created with any tool. To achieve high accuracy, we obtain a coarse physics prior from a fast method of moments simulation of capacitance, then train the model to correct this prior. On 4,009 test designs withheld from training data the model outputs agree with Q3D simulations to a median error of 0.177%, and on never-seen component families it stays below 1% error. We demonstrate the model's scaling by obtaining the capacitance matrix of a 9-superconducting-qubit device in 12 seconds on a laptop (compared to 19.9 h and 228 GB of memory in Ansys) with sub-percent error, and capacitance of a (too large to simulate) 100-qubit, 781-conductor device in 3.4 min on a laptop. We provide the open-source models and data on SQuADDS and Hugging Face. Our results provide a powerful tool for large-scale accurate circuit design and guide the development of models to bypass other physical simulations.

full_list.title_en: Compositional neural networks for multimodal X-ray and neutron scattering inversion
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Compositional neural networks for multimodal X-ray and neutron scattering inversion
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.29362v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: X-ray and neutron scattering are indispensable for structural characterization across condensed-matter physics and materials science. Yet, because scattering experiments generally record intensities without phase information, distinct structures can yield similar scattering patterns, rendering the corresponding inverse problems non-unique. This ambiguity can be reduced by combining complementary measurements, but their integration into machine-learning frameworks remains challenging. Here we introduce a modular framework for probabilistic multi-measurement analysis based on prior-amortized flow matching. Single-observation posterior estimators are trained separately for individual observation types or physical probes and combined only at inference time through a compositional sampler. This late fusion approach allows pretrained single-observation models to be reused without dedicated joint retraining. As a case in point, we consider reflectometry, which provides depth-resolved, nanometer-scale information about thin films and interfaces. Our single-observation demonstrations span X-ray, time-of-flight neutron and polarized neutron reflectometry. In separate co-refinement studies, task-matched estimators enable homogeneous composition across multiple neutron contrasts and heterogeneous multimodal composition of X-ray and neutron measurements. Together, these results establish compositional flow matching as a modular approach to uncertainty-aware inversion and co-refinement, with potential applicability to other scattering problems in which multiple observations constrain a common physical structure while retaining measurement-specific parameters.

full_list.title_en: Singular layer neural networks for the Navier-Stokes equations at small viscosity
full_list.title_zh: 小粘度下纳维-斯托克斯方程的单层神经网络
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.22072v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop neural network methods for the two-dimensional incompressible Navier-Stokes equations at a small viscosity ε > 0, whose accuracy is uniform in ε and whose residual is evaluated on a grid that does not resolve the vorticity boundary layer. In the vorticity-stream function formulation with the slip boundary conditions, a vorticity layer of width sqrtε forms along the walls. The trial function of the singular layer Physics-Informed Neural Network (sl-PINN) contains the corrector of the asymptotic analysis, together with the law that fixes its amplitude at the wall. The amplitude is tied to the wall trace of the network itself, so that the method requires no a priori knowledge of the limit solution. The sl-PINN keeps the error uniform in ε over six decades, for the Stokes and the Navier-Stokes equations alike, although in the latter the wall trace travels with the flow and is not known in advance. An enrichment that uses the thin scale but leaves the profile and the amplitude of the layer free deteriorates as ε→0. Since the corrector carries the layer analytically, the Laplacian in the residual can be discretized by a finite volume flux difference on a coarse grid. The resulting singular layer Finite Volume Neural Network (sl-FVNN) attains the same uniform accuracy as the sl-PINN, to within the scatter of the random seed, at about half the cost of a training step. The combination of the asymptotic corrector with the coarse-grid finite volume discretization is the main result of this article.

full_list.title_en: Magflow: Differentiable Simulation of Industrial-Grade 6D Magnetic Levitation
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Magflow: Differentiable Simulation of Industrial-Grade 6D Magnetic Levitation
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.23050v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Magnetic levitation with six-degrees-of-freedom enables frictionless transport and micrometer-scale positioning in principle, but low-level control is inherently challenging due to its complex and unstable dynamics. Industrial systems typically rely on deep hardware-software co-design, where mover and stator geometries are jointly designed to enable a compact, hand-crafted approximation of the electromagnetic force computation, thereby keeping control computationally tractable at kilohertz rates. However, this approach imposes overly conservative constraints on the operating workspace and the range of supported mover topologies. Instead of reducing the underlying physics to a hand-crafted approximation, we compute the physics directly. We introduce Magflow, a fully differentiable, GPU-parallel simulator for 6D magnetic levitation. It is used to train the first neural controller for an industrial-grade 6D magnetic levitation system that is learned purely from simulated physics. We show that the learned neural controller transfers zero-shot from simulation to real hardware while satisfying hard real-time constraints at 4 kHz. The learned controller achieves qualitatively new behaviors and even levitates a mover topology for which no hand-crafted solution exists. These results demonstrate that co-design is not a physical necessity for 6D magnetic levitation control. More broadly, control learning from simulated physics can find solutions beyond the reach of control engineering in demanding industrial domains. Source code and demonstration videos are publicly available at https://sites.google.com/view/magflow.

full_list.title_en: quantEM: Quantitative Electron Microscopy Analysis from Differentiable Physics to Neural Priors
full_list.title_zh: quantEM：从可微分物理到神经先验的定量电子显微镜分析
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.21903v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantitative electron microscopy includes imaging, diffraction, spectroscopy, and tomography measurements, and the analysis of these measurements increasingly requires solving inverse problems with physical forward models. Open-source software has made many of these analyses widely available, but most packages are organized around a single modality, so that multimodal analyses require moving data between packages, and new methods cannot easily reuse the physical models and optimizers of existing ones. Here we present quantEM, an open-source Python package for quantitative electron microscopy that uses PyTorch tensors for computation and automatic differentiation, and Zarr for storage. We implement each analysis method by writing a differentiable forward model and choosing a representation, loss function, constraints, and optimizer from a library of components, so that every method runs on CPUs and GPUs, can be saved and resumed, and uses the same calibrated data structures and visualization tools. We describe the current modules, including orientation and strain mapping, direct and iterative ptychography, tomography with neural representations, and X-ray and electron energy-loss spectroscopy, and show how we assemble combined methods such as ptychographic tomography from existing components. quantEM is available under the MIT license, together with documentation, tutorials, and curated example datasets.
full_list.abstract_zh: 定量电子显微镜包括成像、衍射、光谱和断层扫描测量，这些测量的分析越来越需要用物理正演模型解决反演问题。开源软件已使许多此类分析得到广泛应用，但大多数包都是围绕单一模态组织的，因此多模态分析需要在包之间移动数据，并且新方法无法轻松重用现有方法的物理模型和优化器。在这里，我们展示了 quantEM，这是一个用于定量电子显微镜的开源 Python 包，它使用 PyTorch 张量进行计算和自动微分，并使用 Zarr 进行存储。

full_list.implication: 对《quantEM：从可微分物理到神经先验的定量电子显微镜分析》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Neural Network Path Optimization for Finding Transition States on a Machine Learned Potential
full_list.title_zh: 用于查找机器学习电位的过渡状态的神经网络路径优化
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.22272v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Transition states govern chemical reaction rates and outcomes, yet locating them remains a central challenge in computational chemistry. Double-ended search methods find transition states given reactant and product structures, but generally rely on discretized path representations developed for density functional theory, where potential energy surface evaluations are expensive. Machine learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) dramatically reduce this cost and leverage automatic differentiation to access higher-order derivatives efficiently. We introduce Popcornn, a framework to find transition states by optimizing continuous neural network paths atop an MLIP with a parallelized adaptive numerical integrator. This combination eliminates path discretization artifacts, reduces hyperparameter sensitivity, and enables non-local optimization to overcome local features using second-order potential-energy-surface information. Popcornn consistently recovers more correct transition states than standard methods such as nudged elastic band and growing string, across MLIPs on thousands of organic reactions, establishing it as a robust, automation-ready method for high-throughput transition state search. Popcornn's infrastructure is flexible in path objective, integration strategy, and optimization algorithm, making it a practical tool and platform for investigating open questions in MLIP-based path optimization.
full_list.abstract_zh: 过渡态控制着化学反应速率和结果，但定位它们仍然是计算化学中的一个核心挑战。双端搜索方法在给定反应物和产物结构的情况下寻找过渡态，但通常依赖于为密度泛函理论开发的离散路径表示，其中势能表面评估的成本很高。机器学习原子间势（MLIP）极大地降低了这种成本，并利用自动微分来有效地访问高阶导数。我们介绍了 Popcornn，这是一个通过使用并行自适应数值积分器优化 MLIP 上的连续神经网络路径来查找过渡状态的框架。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 过渡态控制着化学反应速率和结果，但定位它们仍然是计算化学中的一个核心挑战。双端搜索方法在给定反应物和产物结构的情况下寻找过渡态，但通常依赖于为密度泛函理论开发的离散路径表示，其中势能表面评估的成本很高。机器学习原子间势（MLIP）极大地降低了这种成本，并利用自动微分来有效地访问高阶导数。我们介绍了 Popcornn，这是一个通过使用并行自适应数值积分器优化 MLIP 上的连续神经网络路径来查找过渡状态的框架。这种组合消除了路径离散伪影，降低了超参数敏感性，并支持非局部优化以使用二阶势能表面信息克服局部特征。在数千个有机反应的 MLIP 中，Popcornn 始终能够比标准方法（例如轻推松紧带和增长弦）恢复更正确的过渡态，使其成为一种强大的、自动化的高通量过渡态搜索方法。 Popcornn 的基础设施在路径目标、集成策略和优化算法方面非常灵活，使其成为研究基于 MLIP 的路径优化中的开放问题的实用工具和平台。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入晶体结构搜索、高通量筛选和材料信息学。从摘要能确认的线索包括：密度泛函理论和电子结构计算，以及AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“用 ML 代理能量和不确定性缩小结构搜索，再对候选做对称性、动力学稳定性、极化/磁序和有限温度筛选，避免只按 0 K 单点能排序”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：晶体结构搜索、高通量筛选和材料信息学已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到新型铁电、磁性、钙钛矿、二维和能源材料候选。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的晶体结构搜索、高通量筛选和材料信息学嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在新型铁电、磁性、钙钛矿、二维和能源材料候选中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“用 ML 代理能量和不确定性缩小结构搜索，再对候选做对称性、动力学稳定性、极化/磁序和有限温度筛选，避免只按 0 K 单点能排序”补充训练/验证集，再比较《用于查找机器学习电位的过渡状态的神经网络路径优化》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Data-driven reconstruction of band dispersion and quantum geometry via Koopman dynamic mode decomposition
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Data-driven reconstruction of band dispersion and quantum geometry via Koopman dynamic mode decomposition
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2605.06199v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a data-driven framework for reconstructing band structures using Koopman operator analysis and dynamic mode decomposition (Koopman-DMD). Instead of deriving spectra from an explicit Hamiltonian, the approach reconstructs band dispersion and modal dynamics directly from spatiotemporal data, including wavefunctions and observables. This framework establishes a correspondence between Hamiltonian Floquet-Bloch decomposition and Koopman-DMD, whereby the extracted DMD modes encode frequencies, decay or growth rates, spatial profiles and projection weights. These quantities allow the reconstruction of spectral functions, local density of states, and delocalized-to-localized measures such as the inverse participation ratio. Also, these extended DMD modes enable inference of quantum-geometric and topological properties, including the quantum metric, Berry curvature and geometric phases. Applications to prototypical one- and two-dimensional tight-binding models, including disordered Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model and its Floquet and non-Hermitian variants, graphene and Haldane models, demonstrate that Koopman-DMD provides a unified route for the data-driven analysis of wave propagation, localization, and topological phases in condensed matter, photonics, and related fields.

full_list.title_en: Synthetic Crystal Data Generation for Diffusion Pretraining in Material Property Prediction
full_list.title_zh: 用于材料特性预测中扩散预训练的合成晶体数据生成
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.22140v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Diffusion-based pretraining has emerged as a powerful strategy for learning transferable representations in graph neural networks for materials property prediction without requiring quantum-mechanical labels such as energies, forces, and stresses for every pretraining structure. However, the method retains a critical dependency: it requires structures residing near local minima of a potential energy surface, which have traditionally been obtained through costly DFT relaxations of known or physically synthesized compounds. This reliance constrains both the scale and the structural diversity of available pretraining data, leaving large regions of crystal structure space unexplored. In this work, we connect diffusion-based pretraining with synthetic structure generation to reduce this bottleneck. We introduce a synthetic data generation pipeline combining three complementary strategies: perturb-and-relax, generative sampling via MatterGen, and protostructure enumeration. Where structural relaxation is required, we use fast machine-learned interatomic potentials instead of performing a new DFT relaxation for each generated structure. We further compare a coordinate-denoising control with continuous-time variance-preserving (VP) and sub-VP diffusion objectives using a randomly initialized Orb-v2 backbone. The source comparison covers seven MatBench property-prediction tasks, and an eighth task, textttmp_gap, is included in the protostructure scaling study. Every synthetic-pretraining condition numerically outperforms random initialization on all seven source-comparison tasks. Scaling the protostructure corpus from 20k to 165k under a fixed 400-epoch schedule numerically matches or exceeds MP-20k pretraining on most tasks; because this protocol increases both data diversity and optimization updates, the result reflects joint data-and-compute scaling.
full_list.abstract_zh: 基于扩散的预训练已成为一种强大的策略，用于学习图神经网络中的可转移表示以进行材料属性预测，而无需每个预训练结构的能量、力和应力等量子力学标签。然而，该方法保留了一个关键的依赖性：它需要位于势能表面局部最小值附近的结构，这些结构传统上是通过已知或物理合成化合物的昂贵的 DFT 弛豫获得的。这种依赖性限制了可用预训练数据的规模和结构多样性，导致晶体结构空间的大片区域未被探索。在这项工作中，我们将基于扩散的预训练与合成结构生成联系起来，以减少这一瓶颈。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 基于扩散的预训练已成为一种强大的策略，用于学习图神经网络中的可转移表示以进行材料属性预测，而无需每个预训练结构的能量、力和应力等量子力学标签。然而，该方法保留了一个关键的依赖性：它需要位于势能表面局部最小值附近的结构，这些结构传统上是通过已知或物理合成化合物的昂贵的 DFT 弛豫获得的。这种依赖性限制了可用预训练数据的规模和结构多样性，导致晶体结构空间的大片区域未被探索。在这项工作中，我们将基于扩散的预训练与合成结构生成联系起来，以减少这一瓶颈。我们引入了一种综合数据生成管道，结合了三种互补策略：扰动和放松、通过 MatterGen 生成采样以及原型结构枚举。在需要结构弛豫的情况下，我们使用快速机器学习的原子间势，而不是对每个生成的结构执行新的 DFT 弛豫。我们使用随机初始化的 Orb-v2 主干网络进一步将坐标去噪控制与连续时间方差保持 (VP) 和子 VP 扩散目标进行比较。源比较涵盖七个 MatBench 属性预测任务，第八个任务 textttmp_gap 包含在原型结构缩放研究中。在所有七个源比较任务上，每个合成预训练条件在数值上都优于随机初始化。在固定的 400 epoch 计划下将原型语料库从 20k 扩展到 165k，在大多数任务上在数字上匹配或超过 MP-20k 预训练；由于该协议增加了数据多样性和优化更新，因此结果反映了数据和计算的联合扩展。

full_list.title_en: An open dataset of gas adsorption in deformable metal-organic frameworks for direct air capture
full_list.title_zh: 用于直接空气捕获的可变形金属有机框架中气体吸附的开放数据集
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2508.03162v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Engineering economical and scalable processes for direct air capture (DAC) from humid air relies on atomistic modeling to search and identify promising sorbent materials from a vast chemical space. Machine learning has emerged as a powerful tool for predicting material properties in an efficient yet accurate manner, but these models require large sets of carefully curated training data. We present the Open DAC 2025 (ODAC25) dataset comprising nearly 60 million DFT single-point calculations for CO2, H2O, N2, and O2 adsorption in ~15,000 MOFs. ODAC25 introduces functionalized MOFs, high-energy adsorbate placements, and synthetically generated frameworks to maximize the versatility of models trained on the dataset. ODAC25 improves upon the accuracy of DFT calculations in previous works and applies engineering intuition from recent work regarding the treatment of adsorbate-induced MOF flexibility. We release state-of-the-art machine-learned interatomic potentials trained on ODAC25 and demonstrate their utility via Henry's coefficient predictions. ODAC25 enables MOF screening for DAC at a resolution previously unattainable.
full_list.abstract_zh: 从潮湿空气中直接捕获空气 (DAC) 的工程经济且可扩展的工艺依赖于原子模型来从广阔的化学空间中搜索和识别有前景的吸附剂材料。机器学习已成为以高效而准确的方式预测材料特性的强大工具，但这些模型需要大量精心策划的训练数据。我们提出了 Open DAC 2025 (ODAC25) 数据集，其中包含约 15,000 个 MOF 中 CO2、H2O、N2 和 O2 吸附的近 6000 万个 DFT 单点计算。

full_list.title_en: Supercell periodicity biases octahedral tilting and energetics in high-entropy perovskite oxides
full_list.title_zh: 超晶胞周期性使高熵钙钛矿氧化物中的八面体倾斜和能量学产生偏差
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.22313v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Odd-period supercells such as 3 × 3 × 5 are often used for equimolar five-component compositions in computational studies of high-entropy perovskite oxides (HEPOs). However, such cells are known to constrain octahedral tilting because they cannot accommodate all standard tilt patterns (Glazer tilt systems). How strongly this constraint affects HEPOs, whose octahedra respond to local cation environments, remains unclear. Here we show that supercell periodicity systematically biases computed octahedral tilting and energetics. Using a machine-learning interatomic potential, we compared odd-period and tilt-commensurate cells for 13 HEPOs. Odd-period cells yielded smaller and less coherent tilts and higher energies, even after configurational averaging. In ~1,700-atom cells, tilt differences persisted in all compositions and energy differences in most. The bias extended to defects, with lower oxygen vacancy formation energies in odd-period cells for strongly tilted compositions. Based on these findings, a simple design rule for equimolar supercells is proposed to lift this constraint.
full_list.abstract_zh: 在高熵钙钛矿氧化物 (HEPO) 的计算研究中，奇数周期超级晶胞（例如 3 × 3 × 5）通常用于等摩尔五组分组合物。然而，已知此类单元会限制八面体倾斜，因为它们无法适应所有标准倾斜模式（Glazer 倾斜系统）。这种限制对 HEPO 的影响有多大，其八面体对局部阳离子环境有反应，目前尚不清楚。在这里，我们表明超晶胞周期性系统地偏置计算的八面体倾斜和能量学。使用机器学习原子间势，我们比较了 13 个 HEPO 的奇数周期和倾斜相当细胞。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 在高熵钙钛矿氧化物 (HEPO) 的计算研究中，奇数周期超级晶胞（例如 3 × 3 × 5）通常用于等摩尔五组分组合物。然而，已知此类单元会限制八面体倾斜，因为它们无法适应所有标准倾斜模式（Glazer 倾斜系统）。这种限制对 HEPO 的影响有多大，其八面体对局部阳离子环境有反应，目前尚不清楚。在这里，我们表明超晶胞周期性系统地偏置计算的八面体倾斜和能量学。使用机器学习原子间势，我们比较了 13 个 HEPO 的奇数周期和倾斜相当细胞。即使在构型平均之后，奇数周期电池也会产生更小、更不相干的倾斜和更高的能量。在约 1,700 个原子的细胞中，所有成分中都存在倾斜差异，大多数成分中都存在能量差异。这种偏差延伸到了缺陷，奇数周期晶胞中强烈倾斜的成分具有较低的氧空位形成能。基于这些发现，提出了一种简单的等摩尔超晶胞设计规则来解除这一限制。

full_list.title_en: MatOS: An Agent Operating System for Materials Research
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：MatOS: An Agent Operating System for Materials Research
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.34203v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Materials research relies on scattered and growing data, knowledge, and simulation tools, and a single study often spans multi-day workflows across literature analysis, computation, and experiment. Large language model agents can now retrieve materials data, operate simulation codes, and close design-synthesis-characterization loops with autonomous laboratories. However, extending these agents with new capabilities, keeping long-running tasks on track, and letting them learn from past tasks and user feedback remain difficult. Here we present MatOS, an agent operating system for materials research with three core components: (1) a layered scientific asset graph that organizes data, knowledge, tools, skills, roles, and workflows as reusable assets; (2) a stateful adaptive workflow that runs tasks as explicit execution graphs with scientific checks, so that they can be resumed and traced; and (3) evidence-driven asset evolution, which revises these assets from execution records and user feedback. On ResearchClawBench, MatOS improves on the previously best-performing agent by 11.15% with the same base model and extends the cost-score Pareto frontier. With a common base model, it outperforms Codex CLI and Claude Code, exceeding Codex CLI by 2.13% on MatTools and 4.17% on SciAgentGym. In eight research cases, MatOS narrowed more than 30 million candidate structures to 97 solid-electrolyte candidates, identified 89 halide variants with higher computed conductivity than their parent structures, linked the force errors of 11 pretrained interatomic potentials to local atomic environments, and supported two new methods that reduce errors by 3.1% and 13.6% relative to their baselines. These results show that organizing research capabilities as reusable, evolving assets enables agents to carry out long, multistage materials studies. Code is available at https://github.com/DingyangLyu/MatOS.

full_list.title_en: Atomic-scale Imaging of Time Reversal Breaking Supercurrents in Bi₂Sr₂CaCu₂O₈
full_list.title_zh: Bi2Sr2CaCu2O₈ 中时间反转断裂超电流的原子尺度成像
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.23060v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A persistent mystery of CuO₂-based high temperature superconductivity has been the mechanism and consequences of time reversal (T)-symmetry breaking. Although theoretical hypotheses focus upon persistent electronic currents as a potential cause, these have been invisible to direct experimental probes. That impasse has recently been removed by development of techniques for atomic-scale supercurrent visualization. Here, by imaging the energy-resolved density of electronic states N(r,E) in Bi₂Sr₂CaCu₂O₈, we search for the specific signatures of flowing supercurrents in a disordered d-wave superconductor. Employing the strategy of artificial neural networks (ANN) for complex quantum matter visualization, we designed a dual-ANN (VMAP) to efficiently implement d-wave supercurrent visualization, achieving imaging of supercurrent speeds V(r) at magnetic fields |B| ≤ μ T in Bi₂Sr₂CaCu₂O₈. Correspondence between specific characteristics of N(r,E) around each supercurrent loop and a quantum "Rosetta Stone" which translates N(r,E) to V(r), emphasizes the validity of V(r) detection and visualization. Then, for hole-densities 0.17 ≤ p ≤ 0.22 we observe statistically repeatable networks of supercurrent flows. Crucially, these supercurrents satisfy Kirchhoff's law at junctions within each network. Further, theoretical predictions for supercurrent speeds V in disordered d-wave superconductors are consistent with measured 1250 m/s < V < 4000 m/s, and with reported magnetic field amplitudes |B| approx 0.1 mT Thus, detection and visualization of these supercurrent loop networks provides unique perspectives on T-symmetry breaking in cuprates. It also emphasizes the accelerating utility of ANN techniques for physics discovery from high data volume quantum matter research.

full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《Bi2Sr2CaCu2O₈ 中时间反转断裂超电流的原子尺度成像》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: A closed-loop framework for perovskite precursor additive discovery
full_list.title_zh: 钙钛矿前驱体添加剂发现的闭环框架
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2605.20242v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Efficient discovery of precursor additives is essential for improving the performance of perovskite solar cells, yet the large chemical space makes conventional trial-and-error screening inefficient. Here we show that LEAP (LLM-driven Exploration via Active Learning for Perovskites), a closed-loop framework combining a domain-specialized language model with active learning, prioritizes perovskite precursor additives under low-data conditions. The model extracts mechanism-relevant knowledge from the literature and converts it into interpretable molecular descriptors for uncertainty-aware Bayesian optimization. On an evaluation drawn from unseen literature, the specialized model provides more mechanism-consistent answers than the tested general-purpose models. In an expert-guided proof-of-concept study, two later-round additives increase average device power conversion efficiencies to 20.13% and 20.87%, compared with 19.25% for the control, and the best device reaches 21.32%. Because only a limited number of candidates are tested prospectively, these results provide preliminary evidence that literature-grounded molecular representations, Bayesian optimization, and expert assessment can support additive discovery for perovskite solar cells.
full_list.abstract_zh: 有效发现前体添加剂对于提高钙钛矿太阳能电池的性能至关重要，但巨大的化学空间使得传统的试错筛选效率低下。在这里，我们展示了 LEAP（LLM 驱动的钙钛矿主动学习探索），这是一个将领域专业语言模型与主动学习相结合的闭环框架，在低数据条件下优先考虑钙钛矿前体添加剂。该模型从文献中提取与机制相关的知识，并将其转换为可解释的分子描述符，以进行不确定性贝叶斯优化。根据从未见过的文献进行的评估，专用模型比经过测试的通用模型提供了更多机制一致的答案。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 有效发现前体添加剂对于提高钙钛矿太阳能电池的性能至关重要，但巨大的化学空间使得传统的试错筛选效率低下。在这里，我们展示了 LEAP（LLM 驱动的钙钛矿主动学习探索），这是一个将领域专业语言模型与主动学习相结合的闭环框架，在低数据条件下优先考虑钙钛矿前体添加剂。该模型从文献中提取与机制相关的知识，并将其转换为可解释的分子描述符，以进行不确定性贝叶斯优化。根据从未见过的文献进行的评估，专用模型比经过测试的通用模型提供了更多机制一致的答案。在专家指导的概念验证研究中，两种后轮添加剂将平均器件功率转换效率提高到 20.13% 和 20.87%，而对照组为 19.25%，最好的器件达到 21.32%。由于只有有限数量的候选者进行了前瞻性测试，这些结果提供了初步证据，表明基于文献的分子表征、贝叶斯优化和专家评估可以支持钙钛矿太阳能电池的添加剂发现。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：主动学习和高通量采样。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对《钙钛矿前驱体添加剂发现的闭环框架》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: DSADiff: Data Structure-Aware Diffusion for Crystal Structure Prediction via Mitigating Complexity- and Imbalance-Induced Biases
full_list.title_zh: DSADiff：通过减轻复杂性和不平衡引起的偏差进行晶体结构预测的数据结构感知扩散
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.22050v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Crystal Structure Prediction (CSP) is an important step in accelerating the generation and discovery of new materials. In recent years, diffusion-based CSP methods have made significant progress. However, existing models still suffer from generation bias when facing diverse materials spaces, while systematic approaches for tracing the sources of such performance variations remain limited. To address this issue, we propose LAS (Layered Analysis Strategy), a mechanism analysis framework that identifies crystal complexity and elemental composition imbalance as two key factors affecting generation difficulty and further reveals their relationships with model generation performance. Building on these findings, we further propose DSADiff (Data Structure-Aware Diffusion), a data structure-aware diffusion model that transforms the key factors identified by LAS into a unified generation difficulty representation and uses it to jointly drive feature modeling and training strategy optimization. This enables the model to adapt its representation and generation capability to samples with different data structures and difficulty levels, thereby mitigating learning bias across samples. Experiments on three CSP benchmark datasets, including Carbon-24, demonstrate that DSADiff consistently improves both Match Rate and RMSE, with a maximum Match Rate improvement of 9%, surpassing existing state-of-the-art methods and achieving new state-of-the-art performance. This work deepens the understanding of diffusion-based CSP models from the perspective of generation bias and provides a new direction for designing less biased generative models for complex materials spaces.
full_list.abstract_zh: 晶体结构预测（CSP）是加速新材料产生和发现的重要一步。近年来，基于扩散的 CSP 方法取得了重大进展。然而，现有模型在面对不同的材料空间时仍然存在生成偏差，而追踪此类性能变化来源的系统方法仍然有限。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了LAS（分层分析策略），这是一种机制分析框架，将晶体复杂性和元素组成不平衡确定为影响生成难度的两个关键因素，并进一步揭示它们与模型生成性能的关系。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 晶体结构预测（CSP）是加速新材料产生和发现的重要一步。近年来，基于扩散的 CSP 方法取得了重大进展。然而，现有模型在面对不同的材料空间时仍然存在生成偏差，而追踪此类性能变化来源的系统方法仍然有限。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了LAS（分层分析策略），这是一种机制分析框架，将晶体复杂性和元素组成不平衡确定为影响生成难度的两个关键因素，并进一步揭示它们与模型生成性能的关系。基于这些发现，我们进一步提出了 DSADiff（Data Structure-Aware Diffusion），一种数据结构感知扩散模型，它将 LAS 识别的关键因素转化为统一的生成难度表示，并用其共同驱动特征建模和训练策略优化。这使得模型能够适应具有不同数据结构和难度级别的样本的表示和生成能力，从而减轻样本之间的学习偏差。在包括 Carbon-24 在内的三个 CSP 基准数据集上进行的实验表明，DSADiff 持续改进了匹配率和 RMSE，最大匹配率改进为 9%，超越了现有的最先进方法并实现了新的最先进性能。这项工作从生成偏差的角度加深了对基于扩散的 CSP 模型的理解，并为复杂材料空间设计偏差较小的生成模型提供了新的方向。

full_list.title_en: Weight-Space Programming for Materials Science
full_list.title_zh: 材料科学的权重空间规划
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.22013v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A materials discovery campaign often begins with almost no measurements of the property it is searching for, and the models that rank candidates or screen the output of a generator then have to be built from those first few labels. Following recent work on weight-space programming, in which a language model writes the weights of a small network directly as text, we show that a general-purpose model, given the task in words, the names of the inputs and a network of 16 hidden units with every weight set to zero, can provide this starting point by filling in all of the weights from what it has learned about materials. With no labels, the networks of the strongest model rank experimental alloys at Spearman co-efficient = 0.64 to 0.79, where the best of five simple descriptors reaches 0.47 to 0.62. They rank the bulk modulus of crystals added during generative discovery loops at 0.95, where the inverse volume per atom reaches 0.89, and 35 phase-equilibrium targets computed with Thermo-Calc at a mean of 0.67, close to the 0.70 of an extrapolation from calculated binary and ternary data. As the prior mean of a Gaussian process they raise the ranking at five labels from 0.35 to 0.69 on alloys and from 0.15 to 0.95 on crystals, and they lower the regret of Bayesian optimization significantly on 4 of 5 experimental tasks and on 13 to 16 of 33 computed targets, depending on how multiple tests are corrected, without raising it significantly on any. The same networks also serve as the mean of a Bayesian neural network and as a screen for the samples of two crystal generators, where they do as well as standard models trained on 400 labeled structures. The gain is confined to the first tens of labels and to targets that no rule or sub-system extrapolation already ranks.
full_list.abstract_zh: 材料发现活动通常从几乎没有对其正在搜索的属性进行测量开始，然后必须根据前几个标签来构建对候选材料进行排名或筛选生成器输出的模型。最近关于权重空间编程的工作，其中语言模型将小型网络的权重直接写为文本，我们表明，一个通用模型，给定单词任务、输入名称和一个由 16 个隐藏单元组成的网络，每个权重设置为零，可以通过填充从材料中学到的所有权重来提供这个起点。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 材料发现活动通常从几乎没有对其正在搜索的属性进行测量开始，然后必须根据前几个标签来构建对候选材料进行排名或筛选生成器输出的模型。最近关于权重空间编程的工作，其中语言模型将小型网络的权重直接写为文本，我们表明，一个通用模型，给定单词任务、输入名称和一个由 16 个隐藏单元组成的网络，每个权重设置为零，可以通过填充从材料中学到的所有权重来提供这个起点。在没有标签的情况下，最强模型的网络将实验合金排序为 Spearman 系数 = 0.64 至 0.79，其中五个简单描述符中最好的达到 0.47 至 0.62。他们将生成发现循环期间添加的晶体的体积模量排名为 0.95，其中每个原子的反体积达到 0.89，使用 Thermo-Calc 计算的 35 个相平衡目标的平均值为 0.67，接近从计算的二元和三元数据推断的 0.70。作为高斯过程的先验平均值，他们将合金上的五个标签的排名从 0.35 提高到 0.69，将晶体上的排名从 0.15 提高到 0.95，并且在 5 个实验任务中的 4 个和 33 个计算目标中的 13 到 16 个上显着降低了贝叶斯优化的遗憾，具体取决于多个测试的校正方式，但没有显着提高任何测试的遗憾。相同的网络还充当贝叶斯神经网络的平均值，并作为两个晶体发生器样本的筛选，它们的作用以及在 400 个标记结构上训练的标准模型。增益仅限于前十个标签以及没有规则或子系统外推已经排名的目标。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”补充训练/验证集，再比较《材料科学的权重空间规划》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Mixture of Polyconvex Neural Potentials for Parametric Hyperelasticity: Towards Foundation Material Models
full_list.title_zh: 参数超弹性的多凸神经势混合：走向基础材料模型
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.00359v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Hyperelastic constitutive models enable modeling large deformations in elastic solids. In common practice, a strain energy density function is prescribed in advance and model-specific parameters are calibrated from experiments. However, many applications require constitutive models for a family of related materials whose mechanical behavior varies with composition. A fixed constitutive model-form may not capture the full range of behavior across the family, while fitting separate forms does not provide a direct way to predict the response of new compositions. Recent work has developed data-driven constitutive models that learn flexible strain energy functions while incorporating key physical constraints. In this work, we propose using mixtures of convex neural potentials based on input convex neural networks as a modular and data efficient approach to modeling material families. Each potential is convex and monotonic with respect to polyconvex strain invariants, while a conditioning network maps material descriptors to mixture weights. We compare the approach with a monolithic partially input-convex neural network using experimental data from PolyJet 3D-printed materials and a synthetic Gent-type benchmark. Across both benchmarks, the mixture architecture generalized better to material descriptors not seen during training. In the PolyJet experimental benchmark, we showed that the mixture architecture is less sensitive to model hyperparameters, while in the Gent-type benchmark it generalized more reliably with sparse data in the material-descriptor space. These results suggest that representing a material family through a small set of shared convex neural potentials provides a useful structural prior for learning descriptor-dependent constitutive behavior from limited data.
full_list.abstract_zh: 超弹性本构模型可以对弹性固体中的大变形进行建模。在通常的实践中，应变能密度函数是预先规定的，并且模型特定的参数是通过实验来校准的。然而，许多应用需要一系列相关材料的本构模型，这些材料的机械行为随成分而变化。固定的本构模型形式可能无法捕获整个家庭的全部行为，而拟合单独的形式并不能提供直接的方法来预测新组合物的响应。最近的工作开发了数据驱动的本构模型，可以学习灵活的应变能函数，同时纳入关键的物理约束。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 超弹性本构模型可以对弹性固体中的大变形进行建模。在通常的实践中，应变能密度函数是预先规定的，并且模型特定的参数是通过实验来校准的。然而，许多应用需要一系列相关材料的本构模型，这些材料的机械行为随成分而变化。固定的本构模型形式可能无法捕获整个家庭的全部行为，而拟合单独的形式并不能提供直接的方法来预测新组合物的响应。最近的工作开发了数据驱动的本构模型，可以学习灵活的应变能函数，同时纳入关键的物理约束。在这项工作中，我们建议使用基于输入凸神经网络的凸神经势混合作为建模材料族的模块化和数据有效的方法。每个势对于多凸应变不变量都是凸的和单调的，而条件网络将材料描述符映射到混合权重。我们使用来自 PolyJet 3D 打印材料的实验数据和合成的 Gent 型基准，将该方法与整体部分输入凸神经网络进行比较。在这两个基准测试中，混合架构更好地概括了训练期间未见过的材料描述符。在 PolyJet 实验基准中，我们表明混合架构对模型超参数不太敏感，而在 Gent 型基准中，它可以更可靠地利用材料描述符空间中的稀疏数据进行泛化。这些结果表明，通过一小组共享的凸神经电位来表示材料族，为从有限的数据中学习描述符相关的本构行为提供了有用的结构先验。

full_list.title_en: Micro-Macro Tensor Neural Surrogates for Uncertainty Quantification in Collisional Plasma
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Micro-Macro Tensor Neural Surrogates for Uncertainty Quantification in Collisional Plasma
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2512.24205v2 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Plasma kinetic equations exhibit pronounced sensitivity to microscopic perturbations in model parameters and data, making reliable and efficient uncertainty quantification (UQ) essential for predictive simulations. However, the cost of uncertainty sampling, the high-dimensional phase space, and multiscale stiffness pose severe challenges to both computational efficiency and error control in traditional numerical methods. These aspects are further emphasized in presence of collisions where the high-dimensional nonlocal collision integrations and conservation properties pose severe constraints. To overcome this, we present a variance-reduced Monte Carlo framework for UQ in the Vlasov--Poisson--Landau (VPL) system, in which neural network surrogates replace the multiple costly evaluations of the Landau collision term. The method couples a high-fidelity, asymptotic-preserving VPL solver with inexpensive, strongly correlated surrogates based on the Vlasov--Poisson--Fokker--Planck (VPFP) and Euler--Poisson (EP) equations. For the surrogate models, we introduce a generalization of the separable physics-informed neural network (SPINN), developing a class of tensor neural networks based on an anisotropic micro-macro decomposition, to reduce velocity-moment costs, model complexity, and the curse of dimensionality. To further increase correlation with VPL, we calibrate the VPFP model and design an asymptotic-preserving SPINN whose small- and large-Knudsen limits recover the EP and VP systems, respectively. Numerical experiments show substantial variance reduction over standard Monte Carlo, accurate statistics with far fewer high-fidelity samples, and lower wall-clock time, while maintaining robustness to stochastic dimension.

full_list.title_en: An energy-based conservative–dissipative latent neural evolution operator for magnetization dynamics
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：An energy-based conservative–dissipative latent neural evolution operator for magnetization dynamics
full_list.abstract: We introduce a reduced-order learning framework that couples a convolutional autoencoder to a structured latent neural ordinary differential equation. A learned scalar generates the latent dynamics through an antisymmetric operator and a positive-definite dissipative operator. The antisymmetric component permits motion along scalar level sets, while the dissipative component decreases the scalar. Adding a coercive quadratic term gives bounded continuous-time latent trajectories and approach to the scalar’s critical set under the stated assumptions. The scalar provides a structural constraint rather than an approximation of physical energy. The encoder, decoder, scalar, and operators are trained jointly on short snapshot windows without time-derivative supervision, physical-energy labels, or dissipation penalties. At inference, one initial state is encoded and evolved continuously in latent space, with decoding only at requested times. We demonstrate the framework on micromagnetic magnetization trajectories from NIST MAG Standard Problem 4 and compare it with dissipative-only dynamics and an unstructured latent neural differential equation. Repeated training runs show competitive observed-horizon accuracy, while selected longer rollouts illustrate improved retention of approximately stationary states relative to the unstructured baseline. These results motivate scalar-generated latent dynamics as an inductive bias for reduced-order prediction and other learning tasks where bounded evolution and equilibrium behavior are important.

full_list.title_en: Non-Destructive Quality Assessment of Permanent Magnets inPedelec Drive Systems via Magnetic Field Mapping and SupportVector Machine Classification
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Non-Destructive Quality Assessment of Permanent Magnets inPedelec Drive Systems via Magnetic Field Mapping and SupportVector Machine Classification
full_list.abstract: This paper presents a non-destructive methodology for quantifying irreversible permanent magnet degradation inpermanent magnet synchronous motors (PMSMs) used in pedelec drive systems, using spatially resolved magnetic-field-mapping [MFM] combined with machine learning classification. Fourteen NdFeB magnets from a daum electronicImpulse2 e-bike drive system were characterized before and after 5,000 km of endurance testing on a biomechanicalHardware-in-the-Loop test bench at Aalen University. Spatially resolved magnetic field mapping was used to obtain fluxdensity distributions for comparison of fully magnetized and degraded magnet states of the permanent magnets. Theresulting difference field maps indicate small but measurable field deviations in the order of a few milliTesla (0.3 to 7.6 mT)across the magnet selection. While these deviations are modest relative to the nominal flux density of over 300 mT, theobserved spatial patterns, concentrated at peripheral magnet regions, show localized demagnetization effects.Twenty-five statistical, spatial, and texture features were extracted from each grayscale field map, including intensitydistribution moments, gradient magnitude statistics, Gray-Level Co-Occurrence Matrix (GLCM) texture parameters, andpercentile distributions. A comparative classification study employing five machine learning algorithms (SVM with linearand RBF kernels, Decision Trees, k-Nearest Neighbors, and Bagged Tree Ensembles) was evaluated using Leave-One-Outcross-validation. The results demonstrate that the proposed methodology is capable of detecting and classifying these smallfield deviations, establishing a baseline framework for non-destructive permanent magnet quality assessment.

full_list.title_en: Learning Similarity-Reduced Ion Kinetics across Scales and Regimes in Capacitively Coupled Plasmas
full_list.title_zh: 学习电容耦合等离子体中跨尺度和范围的相似性降低的离子动力学
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.22165v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Systematic kinetic investigations of discharge-mode and heating-mechanism transitions in low-pressure capacitively coupled plasmas (CCPs) are computationally expensive because particle-in-cell/Monte Carlo collision (PIC/MCC) simulations must resolve the inherently slow ion relaxation.In this Letter, we propose a similarity-reduced ion-kinetic representation and a machine learning (ML) reconstruction method for weakly ionized Boltzmann-Poisson discharge systems.Using discharge similarity, the three-dimensional control parameter space, comprising gas pressure p, gap distance d, and driving frequency f, is reduced into a two-dimensional similarity space (pd, fd).A dual-branch ML model predicts the ion density profile at the reference scale and the conditional ion velocity distribution.Taking a 1D3V argon discharge as the paradigm, we use the reconstructed ion kinetic state to initialize the PIC/MCC simulation, which then relaxes to a self-consistent periodic steady state after only a brief evolution.Compared to conventional uniform initializations, this approach achieves a maximum computational speedup of 56.8 times and a median speedup of 27.7 times.Furthermore, the physical regimes of complex nonlinear discharge transitions, including the alpha--gamma mode transition, local-to-nonlocal electron collisional heating mode transition and low-density jumps, are accurately mapped within the similarity space.Similarity transformations extend these boundaries across scales, opening a new avenue for rapid kinetic characterization and optimization of radio-frequency plasma sources.
full_list.abstract_zh: 低压电容耦合等离子体（CCP）中放电模式和加热机制转变的系统动力学研究在计算上是昂贵的，因为粒子在细胞/蒙特卡罗碰撞（PIC/MCC）模拟必须解决固有的慢离子弛豫问题。在这封信中，我们提出了弱电离玻尔兹曼-泊松放电系统的相似性降低的离子动力学表示和机器学习（ML）重建方法。利用放电相似性，三维将由气体压力 p、间隙距离 d 和驱动频率 f 组成的控制参数空间简化为二维相似空间 (pd, fd)。双分支 ML 模型预测参考尺度下的离子密度分布和条件离子速度分布。

full_list.title_en: What Do LLMs Use to Judge Synthesis Recipes? An Experimental Analysis on 240 Solid-State Syntheses
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：What Do LLMs Use to Judge Synthesis Recipes? An Experimental Analysis on 240 Solid-State Syntheses
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.22623v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Inorganic materials discovery is increasingly limited by synthesis rather than by material design. Large language models (LLMs) are being adopted to propose synthesis conditions with little experimental evidence of their capabilities and biases. Here, we carry out an experimental synthesis benchmark of 240 experiments across eight known and unknown inorganic oxides and subsequently evaluate an LLM as a zero-shot ranker over fixed banks of solid-state synthesis recipes. For each pair of recipes for the same oxide target, `GPT-5.6-Sol` selects the recipe expected to yield higher target-phase purity. We aggregate these pairwise preferences using a regularized Bradley-Terry model to obtain a ranked list of synthesis recipes for a given target material. By comparison with the actual purity, obtained through X-ray diffraction, we measure `GPT-5.6-Sol`'s performance as a zero-shot ranker (0.72 pairwise accuracy). By selective removal of the information exposed to the model during this ranking, we conclude that ranking is driven predominantly by thermal features, with reaction chemistry modulating the effect. Ranking accuracy tracks the purity-temperature correlation by target (Spearman ρ = 0.91), (p = 0.002), and on the six thermally-driven targets withholding all chemical identity hardly impacts performance (0.68) compared to withholding temperature (0.56). Ranking performance was higher on known than unknown targets, but the group-level difference was not statistically conclusive. The methodological choices highlight the need for more experimentally validated synthesis benchmarks and position LLMs as a thermally informed prior.

full_list.title_en: From Temperature-Limited to Battery-Limited Legged Locomotion
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：From Temperature-Limited to Battery-Limited Legged Locomotion
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.22231v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: On legged robots, sustained locomotion often ends in thermal shutdown rather than battery depletion: the heat of walking concentrates in a few joint motors, which overheat long before the battery is empty. We train thermally aware locomotion policies by reinforcement learning without ever observing temperature, and demonstrate this on a Unitree Go2 quadruped. We first identify a coupled 13-node lumped RC thermal network, fitted on two runs of a single robot and calibrated against the measured electrical power, that predicts all twelve motor temperatures with a mean RMSE below 1 ^circC across different robot instances, gaits, payloads, and speeds. Under a sustained gait, the temperatures the motors will settle at follow directly from the gait-averaged squared torques and joint speeds. Our core contribution is a reward that drives down the hottest predicted asymptotes: thermal time constants exceed the credit-assignment horizon of reinforcement learning by orders of magnitude, but predicted asymptotes respond to torque and joint speed within a single gait cycle, so the policy learns to lower and spread heat with no temperature input. On the robot, the policy turns sustained locomotion from temperature-limited to battery-limited: with a 5 kg payload at 1 m/s, a learned baseline reaches thermal shutdown after 19 minutes (1.1 km), whereas our policy runs the battery down after 174 minutes (10.0 km) with its hottest motor 14 ^circC below the shutdown threshold in a 26 ^circC room; on an unloaded factory circuit with stairs and ramps, the baseline overheats after 25 laps (6.2 km), while our policy completes 47 (11.2 km) on one battery with 22 ^circC of margin.

full_list.title_en: Domain walls of a spin-chirality ferroelectric as tunable quantum particles
full_list.title_zh: 作为可调谐量子粒子的自旋手性铁电体的畴壁
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.22662v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In frustrated spin chains with competing nearest- and next-nearest-neighbor exchange, the vector spin chirality sets the electric polarization, so a ferroelectric domain wall is a domain wall of the chirality. The semiclassical picture suggests nonlocal switching dynamics due to topological constraints on the spins, but little is known about such domain walls in a quantum spin chain. Using density-matrix renormalization group calculations for a frustrated spin-1/2 XXZ chain in which a bond alternation δ opens a spin gap, we show that the wall then becomes a quantum particle. In a finite chain, it has the energy levels and wave functions of a particle in a box, and it moves under an electric field as a particle under a constant force does. In the infinite chain, its mass grows by more than two orders of magnitude as δ decreases and diverges at δ^*approx0.012, where the bottom of its band becomes flat; below δ^* the band has two degenerate minima away from its center. The large mass results from a near cancellation of in-plane and out-of-plane exchange energies.
full_list.abstract_zh: 在具有竞争性最近邻和次近邻交换的受挫自旋链中，矢量自旋手性决定了电极化，因此铁电畴壁是手性的畴壁。半经典图表明由于自旋的拓扑约束而产生的非局域切换动力学，但人们对量子自旋链中的此类畴壁知之甚少。使用密度矩阵重正化群计算受挫的自旋 1/2 XXZ 链（其中键交替 δ 打开自旋间隙），我们表明壁随后变成了量子粒子。在有限链中，它具有盒子中粒子的能级和波函数，并且它在电场下移动，就像粒子在恒定力下一样。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 在具有竞争性最近邻和次近邻交换的受挫自旋链中，矢量自旋手性决定了电极化，因此铁电畴壁是手性的畴壁。半经典图表明由于自旋的拓扑约束而产生的非局域切换动力学，但人们对量子自旋链中的此类畴壁知之甚少。使用密度矩阵重正化群计算受挫的自旋 1/2 XXZ 链（其中键交替 δ 打开自旋间隙），我们表明壁随后变成了量子粒子。在有限链中，它具有盒子中粒子的能级和波函数，并且它在电场下移动，就像粒子在恒定力下一样。在无限链中，随着 δ 减小，其质量增加两个数量级以上，并在 δ^*approx0.012 处发散，此时带的底部变得平坦；低于 δ^* 时，能带有两个远离其中心的简并极小值。大质量是由于面内和面外交换能量几乎抵消而产生的。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”补充训练/验证集，再比较《作为可调谐量子粒子的自旋手性铁电体的畴壁》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: A Correlated Route to Antiferromagnetic Spintronics
full_list.title_zh: 反铁磁自旋电子学的相关途径
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2603.16552v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Antiferromagnets are attractive for spintronics owing to their vanishing net magnetization and ultrafast spin dynamics, yet their spin-compensated electronic structure has long confined them to passive roles. Here we identify a symmetry selection rule that overcomes this limitation: in a collinear antiferromagnet, a spin-polarized dc charge current requires the simultaneous breaking of particle--hole symmetry and of the equivalence between the two magnetic sublattices, either one alone leaving the polarization identically zero. We demonstrate the rule in the doped antiferromagnetic Hubbard model within dynamical mean-field theory: doping and a uniform magnetic field each break one of the two symmetries, and electronic correlations convert the resulting asymmetries into a sizable, field-tunable polarization of the charge current. The polarization is largest deep in the ordered phase and reverses sign at an emergent compensation point, set by the hierarchy of spin-dependent scattering rates and not dictated by symmetry, at which the dominant conducting spin species is interchanged. In correlated altermagnetic Hubbard models, the same two symmetries are broken structurally, by the sublattice-alternating hopping pattern: the field-driven mechanism identified here and the altermagnetic one are two realizations of a single selection rule. Electronic correlations thus emerge as an active ingredient for spintronics in structurally conventional collinear antiferromagnets.
full_list.abstract_zh: 反铁磁体由于其消失的净磁化强度和超快自旋动力学而对自旋电子学很有吸引力，但其自旋补偿电子结构长期以来将它们限制在被动角色。在这里，我们确定了克服这一限制的对称选择规则：在共线反铁磁体中，自旋极化直流充电电流需要同时打破粒子-空穴对称性和两个磁性亚晶格之间的等价性，其中任何一个都使极化完全为零。我们证明了动态平均场理论中掺杂反铁磁哈伯德模型的规则：掺杂和均匀磁场各自打破了两种对称性之一，并且电子相关性将由此产生的不对称性转换为相当大的、场可调的充电电流极化。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 反铁磁体由于其消失的净磁化强度和超快自旋动力学而对自旋电子学很有吸引力，但其自旋补偿电子结构长期以来将它们限制在被动角色。在这里，我们确定了克服这一限制的对称选择规则：在共线反铁磁体中，自旋极化直流充电电流需要同时打破粒子-空穴对称性和两个磁性亚晶格之间的等价性，其中任何一个都使极化完全为零。我们证明了动态平均场理论中掺杂反铁磁哈伯德模型的规则：掺杂和均匀磁场各自打破了两种对称性之一，并且电子相关性将由此产生的不对称性转换为相当大的、场可调的充电电流极化。极化在有序相深处最大，并在出现的补偿点处反转符号，该补偿点由自旋相关散射率的层次结构设置，而不是由对称性决定，在该补偿点，占主导地位的导电自旋物种被互换。在相关的交变磁哈伯德模型中，相同的两种对称性在结构上被亚晶格交替跳跃模式打破：此处确定的场驱动机制和交变磁机制是单一选择规则的两种实现。因此，电子相关性成为结构传统共线反铁磁体中自旋电子学的活性成分。

full_list.title_en: Coherent high-velocity chiral magnons in the metallic altermagnet CrSb
full_list.title_zh: 金属交变磁体 CrSb 中的相干高速手性磁振子
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2511.16086v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Altermagnets combine the zero net magnetization of antiferromagnets with momentum-dependent spin splitting, creating new opportunities for spintronic and magnonic technologies. The full realization of this promise necessitates a material that is simultaneously metallic and altermagnetic, yet preserves the long magnon lifetimes more often seen in insulators. Here, we use polarized neutron diffraction and inelastic neutron scattering to determine the magnetic structure and spin dynamics of the metallic altermagnet CrSb. We confirm a fully compensated, collinear magnetic structure with localized Cr moments and establish the microscopic spin Hamiltonian governing its excitations. Despite its metallicity, CrSb hosts remarkably coherent magnons across its 230 meV bandwidth, with group velocities approaching 60 km/s. Along low-symmetry momentum directions, we resolve chiral magnon splitting generated by higher-order, symmetry-inequivalent exchange interactions, providing the first experimental observation of this phenomenon in a metallic altermagnet. These results reveal a nearly complete separation between magnetic and electronic degrees of freedom in CrSb and demonstrate that metallic transport, room-temperature altermagnetic order, fast coherent magnons, and chiral spin dynamics can coexist in a single material, positioning CrSb as a compelling platform for spintronic applications.
full_list.abstract_zh: 交替磁体将反铁磁体的零净磁化强度与动量相关的自旋分裂相结合，为自旋电子和磁波束技术创造了新的机遇。要充分实现这一承诺，就需要一种同时具有金属性和交变磁性的材料，同时又能保持绝缘体中常见的长磁振子寿命。在这里，我们使用偏振中子衍射和非弹性中子散射来确定金属交变磁体 CrSb 的磁性结构和自旋动力学。我们确认了具有局部 Cr 矩的完全补偿的共线磁结构，并建立了控制其激发的微观自旋哈密顿量。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 交替磁体将反铁磁体的零净磁化强度与动量相关的自旋分裂相结合，为自旋电子和磁波束技术创造了新的机遇。要充分实现这一承诺，就需要一种同时具有金属性和交变磁性的材料，同时又能保持绝缘体中常见的长磁振子寿命。在这里，我们使用偏振中子衍射和非弹性中子散射来确定金属交变磁体 CrSb 的磁性结构和自旋动力学。我们确认了具有局部 Cr 矩的完全补偿的共线磁结构，并建立了控制其激发的微观自旋哈密顿量。尽管具有金属性，CrSb 在其 230 meV 带宽内仍具有非常相干的磁振子，群速度接近 60 km/s。沿着低对称动量方向，我们解决了由高阶、对称不等价交换相互作用产生的手性磁振子分裂，首次在金属交变磁体中实验观察到这种现象。这些结果揭示了 CrSb 中磁自由度和电子自由度之间几乎完全分离，并证明金属输运、室温交变磁序、快速相干磁振子和手性自旋动力学可以在单一材料中共存，使 CrSb 成为自旋电子应用的一个引人注目的平台。

full_list.title_en: Prior-guided adaptive local refinement of foundation interatomic potentials
full_list.title_zh: 基础原子间势的先验引导自适应局部细化
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.22626v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Foundation interatomic potentials enable simulations across diverse materials, but task-specific inaccuracies can require additional first-principles data. Obtaining these data is challenging when the relevant local environments arise in large simulation cells. Here we introduce the Prior-guided Adaptive Refinement Scheme (PARS), which identifies weakly supported environments during molecular dynamics by comparing their frozen representations with prototypes of pretraining environments, without requiring initial task labels or model ensembles. Selected environments are reconstructed as compact periodic cells for first-principles labelling and iterative refinement. Applications to phase stability, surface migration and vacancy clustering show improvements in target properties, including an 81% reduction in the mean absolute error of Ti vacancy-cluster energies per vacancy relative to the pretrained model. For Si/Ge, a foundation potential refined using 800 labelled cells containing 10-128 atoms is subsequently distilled into a compact potential without additional first-principles training labels. In simulations containing approximately 362,880 atoms, the distilled model predicts an interfacial thermal resistance consistent with that of a potential trained directly on density-functional theory data. These results demonstrate a route for adapting foundation potentials to target applications through local reference calculations.
full_list.abstract_zh: 基础原子间势能实现跨不同材料的模拟，但特定任务的不准确性可能需要额外的第一原理数据。当大型模拟单元中出现相关的局部环境时，获取这些数据具有挑战性。在这里，我们介绍了先验引导的自适应细化方案（PARS），该方案通过将其冻结表示与预训练环境的原型进行比较来识别分子动力学过程中的弱支持环境，而不需要初始任务标签或模型集成。选定的环境被重建为紧凑的周期单元，用于第一原理标记和迭代细化。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合。从摘要能确认的线索包括：分子动力学与有限温度轨迹, 第一性原理标注与结构优化, 相稳定、相图与多相竞争，以及缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 声子、有限温度和输运性质, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”补充训练/验证集，再比较《基础原子间势的先验引导自适应局部细化》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Dynamics of a Single-Domain Dissipative Magnetic Gyroscope in Electric and Magnetic Fields
full_list.title_zh: 电场和磁场中单域耗散磁陀螺的动力学
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.23167v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We formulate the coupled spin--rotation dynamics of a single-domain symmetric top ferromagnetic needle (a magnetic gyroscope) in static magnetic and electric fields. The conservative Hamiltonian contains the rotational kinetic energy, the magnetocrystalline and shape anisotropy, the Zeeman energy, the electrostatic energy of the dipole induced in the conducting needle, the linear magnetoelectric coupling, and the relativistic motional (spin-orbit) coupling. Gilbert damping is introduced, and in an electric field, Debye relaxation of the induced electric dipole of the conducting needle also results in dissipation. We give the equations of motion in the laboratory and body-fixed frames, with singularity-free quaternion kinematics. For a 120-nm-long single-domain cobalt needle in a 0.5~T field we find: (i) because the anisotropy field (approx 1.3~T) exceeds the applied magnetic field, the spin reverses direction several times during the initial Gilbert-damping transient, and the parity of the number of reversals determines whether the easy axis ends up parallel or antiparallel to the spin; (ii) after the transient the needle librates about the field---precession accompanied by nutation at twice the precession frequency---with a period of about 20~ns, consistent with the libration period 2π(I₁/μ B)¹/², while the Zeeman and rotational kinetic energies oscillate out of phase and the total energy is conserved; (iii) a static electric field mathbf E exerts on the conducting needle a shape-dependent polarization torque that tends to align the long axis of the needle with mathbf E. The torques due to the magnetoelectric interaction and motional magnetic fields (lesssim1~μT) are negligible compared with the polarization torque. A conducting needle can therefore serve as a magnetometer only if Ell E_c.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们制定了静态磁场和电场中单域对称顶部铁磁针（磁陀螺仪）的耦合自旋-旋转动力学。保守哈密顿量包含旋转动能、磁晶和形状各向异性、塞曼能量、导电针中感应的偶极子静电能、线性磁电耦合和相对论运动（自旋轨道）耦合。引入了吉尔伯特阻尼，并且在电场中，导电针的感应电偶极子的德拜弛豫也会导致耗散。我们给出了实验室和身体固定框架中的运动方程，具有无奇点四元数运动学。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们制定了静态磁场和电场中单域对称顶部铁磁针（磁陀螺仪）的耦合自旋-旋转动力学。保守哈密顿量包含旋转动能、磁晶和形状各向异性、塞曼能量、导电针中感应的偶极子静电能、线性磁电耦合和相对论运动（自旋轨道）耦合。引入了吉尔伯特阻尼，并且在电场中，导电针的感应电偶极子的德拜弛豫也会导致耗散。我们给出了实验室和身体固定框架中的运动方程，具有无奇点四元数运动学。对于 0.5~T 场中的 120 nm 长的单畴钴针，我们发现：（i）由于各向异性场（约 1.3~T）超过了施加的磁场，自旋在初始吉尔伯特阻尼瞬态过程中多次反转方向，反转次数的奇偶性决定了易轴最终是否与自旋平行或反平行； (ii) 瞬态后，针围绕场进行振动——进动伴随着两倍进动频率的章动——周期约为20ns，与振动周期2π(I₁/μB)1/2一致，而塞曼和旋转动能异相振荡，总能量守恒； (iii) 静电场 mathbf E 对导电针施加形状相关的极化扭矩，该扭矩倾向于使针的长轴与 mathbf E 对齐。与极化扭矩相比，磁电相互作用和运动磁场 (lesssim1~μT) 产生的扭矩可以忽略不计。因此，只有当 Ell E_c 时，导电针才能充当磁力计。

full_list.title_en: Evidence for crystal-field-selected octupolar order in wolframite oxides
full_list.title_zh: 黑钨矿氧化物中晶体场选择八极有序的证据
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2503.18694v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Magnetic order can involve higher-rank moments such as octupoles, which are difficult to identify in strongly distorted crystals. Here we present evidence for predominantly octupolar order in the monoclinic wolframites MgReO₄ and ZnReO₄. Muon spin spectroscopy detects magnetic transitions near 83 and 126 K, respectively, with similar precession frequencies in both compounds. An ab initio effective Hamiltonian shows that strong crystal fields split the spin--orbit quartet, isolating low-energy doublets with weak dipolar character. Exchange selects octupole-dominated order in distinct collinear antiferromagnetic structures, with moments along b in MgReO₄ and tilted within the ac plane in ZnReO₄. The estimated dipole moments of 0.06 and 0.12 μB per Re, respectively, are consistent with the absence of a resolved magnetic contribution in neutron powder diffraction. A single-ion model illustrates how octupolar states generate local fields with a vanishing net dipole moment. These findings support a crystal-field route to hidden magnetism beyond double perovskites.
full_list.abstract_zh: 磁序可能涉及更高阶的矩，例如八极子，这在强烈扭曲的晶体中很难识别。在这里，我们提出了单斜黑钨矿 MgReO₄ 和 ZnReO₄ 中主要是八极有序的证据。 μ 子自旋光谱分别检测到 83 K 和 126 K 附近的磁跃迁，两种化合物具有相似的进动频率。从头算有效的哈密顿量表明，强晶体场分裂了自旋轨道四重态，隔离了具有弱偶极特性的低能双态。交换在不同的共线反铁磁结构中选择八极主导的顺序，其中 MgReO₄ 中的力矩沿 b 方向，ZnReO₄ 中的力矩在 ac 平面内倾斜。

full_list.title_en: Expressivity of two-dimensional Gaussian fermion tensor network states
full_list.title_zh: 二维高斯费米子张量网络状态的表达能力
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.23227v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Tensor network states (TNS) provide a family of efficiently compressed approximations to physically relevant many-body quantum states. An important quantity that characterizes the computational resources required by a TNS is its bond dimension. While in one dimension an area law for the Renyi-0 entropy guarantees an exact matrix product state representation with a bond dimension independent of the system size, an analogous statement does not hold for general states in two dimensions (2D). This leaves open the question of how the expressivity of 2D TNS is related to the entanglement properties of the states they represent. In this work, we focus on two families of 2D translation-invariant Gaussian fermionic states: single-band BCS superconductors and half-filled two-band insulators (including semimetals). For each family, we prove that an area law for the Renyi-0 entropy is equivalent to having an exact Gaussian fermionic TNS representation with a finite bond dimension determined by the Renyi-0 entropy. We also establish equivalent characterizations in terms of compactly supported Wannier-type orbitals and the momentum-space wavefunction, relating the spatial extent of these orbitals and the structure of the wavefunction to the required bond dimension.
